narr: Another round of strong storms produced heavy rainfall across the area, resulting in flash flooding during the afternoon of May 15.
ev: N Eldridge Pkway was made impassable due to floodwaters between FM 1960 and Falbrook.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 4 NW JERSEY VILLAGE. N ELDRIDGE PKWY IMPASSABLE BETWEEN 1960 AND FALLBROOK.
